title: Computational Evaluation of Abrogation of HBx-Bcl-xL Complex with High-Affinity Carbon Nanotubes (Fullerene) to Halt the Hepatitis B Virus Replication.
authors: Khan, Abbas; Ahsan, Omar; Wei, Dong-Qing; Ansari, Jawad Khaliq; Najmi, Muzammil Hasan; Muhammad, Khalid; Waheed, Yasir
one_liner_zh: 该研究用计算结构生物学评估碳纳米管抑制HBx-Bcl-xL蛋白复合物，对象为蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD结合建模方法，与本课题TF-DNA互作研究关联极弱。
abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) is the world's most prevalent chronic viral infection. More than 350 million individuals are chronic carriers of the virus, with an estimated 2 billion infected persons. For instance, the role of HBx protein in attachment and infection is very obvious and consequently deemed as an important druggable target. Targeting the interface and discovering novel drugs greatly advanced the field of therapeutics development. Therefore, in the current study, HBx to Bcl-xL is abrogated on high-affinity carbon nanotubes using computational structural biology tools. Our analysis revealed that among the total 62 carbon fullerenes, only 13 compounds exhibited inhibitory activity against HBx, which was further confirmed through IFD-based rescoring. Structural dynamics investigation revealed stable binding, compactness, and hydrogen bonds reprogramming. Moreover, the binding free energy calculation results revealed that the top hits1-4 possess the total binding energy of -54.36 kcal/mol (hit1), -50.81 kcal/mol (hit2), -47.09 kcal/mol (hit3), and -45.59 kcal/mol for hit4. In addition, the predicted K(D) values and bioactivity scores further validated the inhibitory potential of these top hits. The identified compounds need further in vitro and in vivo validation to aid the treatment process of HBV.
abstract_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒（HBV）是全球最普遍的慢性病毒感染。超过3.5亿人是该病毒的慢性携带者，估计有20亿人感染。例如，HBx蛋白在附着和感染中的作用非常明显，因此被视为重要的药物靶点。靶向该界面并发现新药物极大地推动了治疗开发领域的发展。因此，在本研究中，利用计算结构生物学工具，HBx与Bcl-xL的相互作用在高亲和力碳纳米管上被阻断。我们的分析显示，在总共62种碳富勒烯中，仅有13种化合物对HBx表现出抑制活性，这通过基于IFD的重新评分进一步确认。结构动力学研究揭示了稳定的结合、紧凑性以及氢键重编程。此外，结合自由能计算结果显示，前四名命中化合物（hit1-4）的总结合能分别为-54.36 kcal/mol（hit1）、-50.81 kcal/mol（hit2）、-47.09 kcal/mol（hit3）和-45.59 kcal/mol（hit4）。另外，预测的K(D)值和生物活性评分进一步验证了这些顶级命中化合物的抑制潜力。所识别的化合物需要进一步的体外和体内验证，以辅助HBV的治疗过程。
